changes: Adds a real live progress bar to the v3.6.34 TV Manual Media Import flow while Import & Organize is running.
Reports current import phase/file plus byte-based progress for cross-volume copies using the existing Smart Import transaction progress callback rather than a simulated timer.
Keeps the Import Media modal open and temporarily locks its controls during an active import, then reports files organized and Wanted targets satisfied at completion.
Reserves completion for authoritative library and Wanted reconciliation so 100% is shown only after the imported media is fully accounted for.
regression_guards: v3.6.34 Manual Media Import mapping, preview, transactional organization, and immediate Wanted reconciliation remain the implementation baseline.
Import start rebuilds/revalidates the plan and refuses unresolved NEEDS_ATTENTION media before transaction work begins; live progress does not weaken Preview safety.
Existing library files remain protected by the v3.6.32 no-downgrade/final physical-target revalidation path; equal, worse, duplicate, or indeterminate media cannot overwrite the better existing copy.
v3.6.33 TV-edition search aliases and the accepted v3.6.28-v3.6.31 SAB/download-control stack remain unchanged except for required v3.6.35 release identity markers.
name: Manual Import Live Progress
